Derived all 1,844 ordered zero derivations by hand (fixed-point support closure) and recorded variable + original_support_row in audit.json['zero_derivations'].

Derived the block decomposition by hand: 33,684 residual rows grouped into 3,816 classes by (source exact-one group, complete support set), paired into 1,908 reciprocal blocks with a verified unique reverse partner, then 144 edges with category sets partitioning both endpoints.

Chose the omissions and their certificates by hand: 144 omitted category equalities (largest coefficient count, deterministic tie-break) plus 3 original equalities NOD0/NOD1/NOD21, written into audit.json['edge_dependencies'] and ['removed_original_equalities'].
Wrote the final fixed-field MPS and a third decoder to audit it (2,109,426 B audit.json, verification.json PASS over 9 named checks, SHA-256 of both models).
